backlog.market: Durable medical equipment (DME) suppliers - documentation and billing compliance

backlog.market: Independent pharmacy third-party reconciliation and PBM claw-backs

backlog.market: Ambulance and EMS billing

backlog.market: Patient financial counseling and No Surprises Act Good Faith Estimate compliance

backlog.market: Anesthesia and pain management billing
backlog.note: Base units plus time units plus modifiers make payment verification a formula the PM system rarely checks; concentrated in small independent groups.

backlog.market: Medicare Advantage risk adjustment / HCC coding at small groups
backlog.note: Annual recapture of chronic conditions is a documentation-completeness problem with direct revenue impact and growing audit exposure (RADV).

backlog.market: Mobile notary and loan signing service operators
backlog.note: Highest-volume observers of executed-package defects; 1-5 person businesses scheduling, tracking and QCing signings with email and spreadsheets.

backlog.market: Mortgage servicer payoff and lien release departments
backlog.note: The counterparty on the other side of P3 and P5; 7-business-day payoff statutes and 30-90 day satisfaction deadlines make it a deadline-ledger market.

backlog.market: County recorder offices - document intake, indexing and rejection handling

backlog.market: Independent escrow companies (California DFPI-licensed, non-title)

backlog.market: 1031 exchange qualified intermediaries
backlog.note: 45-day identification and 180-day exchange clocks with catastrophic consequences for missing them; tiny firms holding large sums.

backlog.market: Unclaimed property and escheat compliance service providers

backlog.market: Real estate closing law firms in attorney-opinion and attorney-closing states

backlog.market: HOA and condominium management companies - estoppel and demand response desk

backlog.market: Mortgage post-closing QC and trailing document vendors

backlog.market: Remote online notarization (RON) platform operators and RON-commissioned notaries

backlog.market: Commercial title and escrow for multi-property portfolio closings
